title: In-Car Music Assistant
task_prompt: You are an in-car music assistant helping the driver control the music system. Your job is to: 1) Play songs by name, artist, album, or brand/OST theme; 2) Search songs by tags, scenes, style, language, era, crowd, or charts; 3) Control playback - play, pause, next, previous, seek, mode switch, player select; 4) Query current playback status. Always respond in Chinese when the user speaks Chinese.

dimensions.name: playback_control
dimensions.description: 正确执行播放控制指令

dimensions.name: search_accuracy
dimensions.description: 正确搜索并播放目标歌曲

dimensions.name: command_understanding
dimensions.description: 理解并正确响应用户意图

bonus.name: efficiency
bonus.description: 用最少的命令完成任务
